# Phase Three — Final Bookshelf Architecture

The Awtsmoos is one before memory becomes group, card, action, or empty room;
Awtsmoos.com lets each concern enter a smaller vessel so future growth creates branches instead of monolithic gloom.

## Final architecture

- `ui/bookshelf.js`: stable public gateway only.
- `ui/bookshelf/TiferesBookshelfView.js`: grouping, root clearing, section order, empty state.
- `ui/bookshelf/MalchusBookshelfCardFactory.js`: safe DOM section/card/action construction.
- `styles/runtime/bookshelf-shell.css`: rail/section/empty/mobile geometry.
- `styles/runtime/bookshelf-cards.css`: card/spine/body/type identity.
- `styles/runtime/bookshelf-interaction.css`: Open/Remove actions, hover/active/focus-visible/disabled/reduced-motion.
- `styles/runtime-ui.css`: import manifest only.

## API law

`renderBookshelf(bookmarks = [], handlers = {})` remains unchanged.
`handlers.onOpen(item)` remains unchanged.
`handlers.onRemove(item.id)` remains unchanged.

## Verification graph

syntax -> line ceiling -> no runtime style -> no innerHTML -> no `.onclick =` -> import graph -> 44px/interactions/mobile -> diff check -> new Bookshelf tests -> complete Rebbe suite -> fresh live route proof -> post-implementation delta -> Studio next.
